messages:
ana_partnerships: Morning — uploading StratusGrid co-marketing assets for review. Need logo lockup, solution brief, and a short case blurb approved for marketplace. Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/example/stratus-collab. Can we get design + legal check by EOD Wed? thanks!
julia_design: Got it. downloading. Quick q — do they want vertical or horizontal lockups? they sent both but the horizontal has extra spacing. attaching preview (file: stratus_lockups_v2.png).
mike_marketing: EOD Wed works. We'll also need a 50-75 word blurb for the marketplace. Ana — can you confirm final customer quote? their PM sent "latency cut 3x" — need to avoid unverified numbers.
stratus_pm: hey team — confirmed quote from beta customer: "we saw a 3x reduction in inference latency after switching to Redwood Dedicated." happy to sign off if legal ok.
tom_legal: Quick read: prefer "up to 3x" or include source. also confirm permissions to use customer's name/quote — did they sign? please upload consent.
ana_note: (bot) uploaded: ./agreements/stratus_customer_blurb_signed.pdf

ana_clarify: uploaded signed blurb confirmed at ./agreements/stratus_customer_blurb_signed.pdf — apologies for noise.
tom_legal: OK downloaded. I'll patch wording to "up to 3x" and add attribution line. will re-upload edited blurb.
julia_design: Also: their brand guide mandates minimum clearspace 100% of logo height for horizontal. Current mock violates on the left. I'll push updated SVGs. also their primary blue #0057b8 is close to our navy — recommend neutral bg on co-branded banners.
mike_marketing: For marketplace tile: can we use this headline? "Redwood + StratusGrid: faster, cheaper LLM inference." Stratus ok?
stratus_pm: prefer "faster, more predictable" — no price claims.
ana_partnerships: noted. updating headline to "Faster, more predictable LLM inference with StratusGrid + Redwood." rollout target: marketplace publish Thu 2024-03-28 — will that work?
mike_marketing: Thu 3/28 is tight. Need final assets by Wed EOD, legal sign-off Wed noon. ops needs 24h to validate listing.
tom_legal: Can sign off by Wed 11am if I get final copy by Tue EOD.
julia_design: I'll upload final lockups + banner + 2 tile sizes by Tue 5pm.
deploy-bot: marketplace-deploy scheduled for 2024-03-28T09:00Z — requires artifact: `marketplace_payload_v3.json`.
ana_partnerships: thanks all. checklist:```- [ ] final logo lockups (SVGs): julia- [ ] solution brief PDF (3p): mike- [ ] customer blurb (signed + edited): tom/stratus- [ ] marketplace tile images (2 sizes): julia- [ ] headline + 75w blurb: mike- [ ] legal sign-off: tom- [ ] deploy artifact: ana```
mike_marketing: i'll take the 75w blurb — drafting now, will drop here for review.
julia_design: FYI I'm also adding alt text for accessibility per their guidelines.
stratus_pm: :thumbsup: thanks for the quick turnaround team.
ana_partnerships: I'll post final links once uploads done. tagging @tom_legal for any high-risk IP clauses.
tom_legal: one more note: partner SVG contains embedded raster — need a clean vector. asking Stratus to re-export.
stratus_pm: they'll re-export and send the clean SVG by Tue noon.
mike_marketing: i'll freeze copy Tue 6pm for final review.
julia_design: done with lockup fixes, uploaded `stratus_lockups_final_v3.svg` and `banner_1200x600_v2.png` to drive.
ana_partnerships: received. thanks julia. Tom, assigning documents in folder: https://drive.redwood/example/stratus-collab/docs
tom_legal: reviewing now. should have comments in doc by 10:30am Wed.
stratus_pm: we can sign micro-edits same day. stand by.
ana_partnerships: great — will update this thread with final marketplace payload once `marketplace_payload_v3.json` is ready and pushed to deploy pipeline.
